verdict.rationale: Zep's Graphiti temporal context graph explicitly documents a bi-temporal model with fact invalidation and tracks how facts change over time while keeping provenance. That is the supersede-on-contradiction behavior the story asks for, and the Zep team says reconciling conflicting facts was the reason they moved to graph-based memory. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of entity/fact merging or deduplication, detail on how contradiction detection and invalidation surface in the hosted Zep API rather than open-source Graphiti, and independent hands-on corroboration that invalidation works reliably.
